results.title: CoachUp Careers and Employment | Indeed.com
results.snippet: CoachUp makes it very easy to start and maintain your own personal coaching business. The website and app are very accessible, easy to use, and have a wide base of potential clients for almost any kind of coach. As with all companies such as these, they do take a sizeable cut of your revenue.

results.title: Career Coach Cost 2026: What Coaches Charge Per Hour
results.snippet: A typical career coaching package is five sessions plus extras like a resume review or email support, priced around $500 to $700. Full start-to-finish programs range from $1,000 to $5,000 depending on depth and the coach's reputation.

results.title: How much does it cost to book training sessions? – CoachUp Help Center
results.snippet: A one-time only Placement Fee of $24.99 applies only to your first booking with a new coach. You will not be charged this fee for any rebookings with your coach.
